purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. DLRS officially offers survey-map search with division/district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet/dag selection and lists Rajshahi within the Rajshahi zonal office jurisdiction. The interface includes khatiyan and owner-name sections; no plot-specific lookup or geometry request was made. Public anonymous full polygon schema, CRS and exact-point coverage remain unverified. No sample retained and no owner/address or identity data queried.
registryAssessment: Bangladesh DLRS provides an official map-search portal for survey plots and records, with division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet, and dag selectors. Its Rajshahi Zonal Settlement Office page lists Rajshahi among the districts under that office. This establishes local cadastral-record/lookup infrastructure, but the interface also surfaces khatiyan/owner fields and no anonymous full-polygon schema was verified, so no plot-specific request was made.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DLRS/Ministry of Land online land-record and survey-management portal; identifies Rajshahi as a zone and provides map-display services.
Official map-search UI provides division/district/survey/upazila-or-thana/mouza/sheet/dag selectors and land/khatiyan information sections. No user/property-specific query made.
Official DLRS Rajshahi Zonal Settlement Office page lists Rajshahi among districts under that zonal office.
Official Department of Land Records and Surveys site describes current map and survey-record services, including online map ordering.
